edition: NR feature guide approved by the owner on October 30, 2026

scenes.title:
Neural rendering.
Your scene, refined.
lines: Live control, from exterior to cockpit
scenes.narration: Explore optional neural rendering before F S R. This experimental update adds live appearance controls and a choice of external views or the full scene, including the cockpit.

scenes.title: Fine tune without restarting.
lines: Adjust strength, tone, color, detail and history
Choose External only or Full scene
scenes.narration: Enable or bypass neural rendering during your flight. Adjust strength, lighting, color, detail and history live. Choose External only, or Full scene to include the cockpit. Your choices are saved.

scenes.title: Balance detail and GPU time.
lines: Model changes prepare while FSR continues
Start with Subtle strength and one pass
scenes.narration: Performance, Balanced and Quality profiles adjust the neural processing resolution. Model changes prepare in the background while F S R continues. Start with Subtle strength and one pass. Lower budgets can reduce detail and processing cost.

scenes.title: Your model stays local.
lines: Import your own supported model DLL with X-Plane closed
Run the separate NR hardware check
Windows RDNA4 preview  /  NR starts Off
scenes.narration: With X Plane closed, import your own supported model D L L, then run the separate hardware check. Model files stay local. This is a Windows R D N A four preview, with neural rendering off by default.

scenes.title: Test at your own pace.
lines: NR + FG needs explicit experimental opt-in
Skip now  /  replay from What’s new
scenes.narration: Start with frame generation off. Combining it with neural rendering needs explicit experimental opt in, and visual or pacing issues remain possible. Skip this guide whenever you like, or replay it from Whats New.
